annotations.title: Company Registry Lookup: Name, Domain, ID, LEI to Legal Entity

description: Resolve a company name, website domain, registry number, LEI or VAT number to its official legal entity: registry, registry number, legal form, status, address, industry codes, size where published and LEI. Searches national registers (Norway, Finland, Czechia, Slovakia, France, UK, Latvia, Estonia on the API and MCP; Poland by KRS number; Brazil by CNPJ, Singapore, Canadian federal corporations on the API and MCP) and GLEIF, scores the match and links every record to its source. Company-level only: no officers, no sole traders. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

country.description: Optional ISO country code (NO, FI, CZ, SK, FR, GB, LV, EE, PL, BR, SG, CA) to search one register only. Faster and more precise.

minScore.description: Only return candidates with a match score of at least this value (for example 90 for KYB checks that must not accept fuzzy matches). A query with no such candidate comes back as matched: false and is not billed.

queries.description: Up to 100 queries in one run (Apify Actor only). Each query that finds a match is one billable result.

query.description: Company name, website domain (example.com), registry number, LEI or VAT number. Use this or queries.
